write_up: Your resume tells a compelling story of growth at Carolina Home & Garden, from Department Supervisor to Store Manager. The sales, turnover and shrink figures make your current work concrete. The one claim a recruiter can't connect to the jobs yet is the turnaround of two stores.

The turnover line is a great model: it names the scheduling change and shows the before and after. Your progression is easy to follow, and your current store's sales and staffing figures show the responsibility you hold.

Start with the headline. If you can show what changed at the other store, add it under that role. If not, lead with the results from your current store. Then give the customer satisfaction ranking a little more context about your work.
